notes: The question is semantically well-defined from MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY: filter to graduate students (STUDENT_YEAR = 'G') with non-null OFFICE_PHONE, aggregate by department, rank departments by descending average phone number, then select the highest-phone graduate student within each top-5 department. STDDEV is explicitly required instead of STDDEV_POP.
question_text: Among all departments, which are the top 5 departments with the highest average office phone number among graduate students (student year 'G') who have a non-null office phone number? For each of these departments, show the department name, the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of office phone numbers, and the full name and office phone number of the graduate student in that department with the highest office phone number. Do not return any rounded answers.
